✨ Get even more results with Gemini

Using Google Chrome on a computer? Chrome has a free Ask Gemini button built right in — no extension or install needed. It only takes two taps:

1. Click Chrome's Ask Gemini button (usually top-right, near the address bar):

2. Copy this prompt and paste it into Gemini:

The Ask Gemini button shown above only works on a computer (laptop or desktop) in Google Chrome — not on a phone or tablet. On a phone, you can still tap Copy Prompt and paste it straight into Google or the Gemini app in your phone's browser — it's completely optional either way, but it's the fastest way to double up on your search.

🔎 How this app looks for deals for you

When you press the Run Quest button, this app asks a few different search helpers to look for deals — not just one. If one helper is busy, it just asks the next one instead. You don't have to do anything — this already happens every time, all by itself.

Want to add Gemini on top of that too? See the "Get even more results with Gemini" box above the search fields — it walks you through it.
